stem:
Anya records two linked quantities. At first, juice is 2 cups and water is 5 cups. Later, juice is 6 cups and water is 15 cups.

Is the change proportional?

options.text: Yes, because juice rose by 4 cups and that additive rise alone settles the question.
Yes for any pair of increases, even when the two quantities grow by unrelated amounts.
Yes, because both quantities were multiplied by the same factor 3.
Yes, because 15 is the largest number printed among the four amounts.

teacher.key_rationale: Proportional change needs one common multiplicative factor on corresponding quantities. Here both were ×3. An additive rise on one quantity alone is not the test. Unrelated growth is out of scope. The largest printed number is not the test.

mx_swap.reason: Mechanism-conflation CWO imports Rule-of-Three setup language not needed once the common-factor check is stated; kept condition_omission, scope_error, surface_feature_capture.
